text:
sara_ops: DeployBot started v2 rollout to eu pool-3 and we're seeing a spike of 422s on streaming endpoints. can ops pause the pool? :eyes:

deploybot: roll id=rb-1766619999 initiated. rollout target: pool-3. current rollout: 10%. error_rate(/v2/stream)=7.2% (alert threshold=1%). alert triggered.

anna_prodeng: digging into traces 1: appears truncation of stream frames for very long contexts (>6k tokens). sample error: ```Error: invalid_chunk_size at chunk 42
headers: Transfer-Encoding: chunked
last-chunk-len: 0x3f```

jon_sre: sounds like the new chunking math in v2 interacts badly with an older nginx proxy config some tenants use. do we have common front proxies for impacted tenants?

sara_ops: top hit tenants are 1234, 9876. pausing rollout for pool-3 now: `deploybot pause rb-1766619999 --pool pool-3`

deploybot: pause acknowledged for pool-3. remaining regions unaffected. rollout halted to pool-3.

mike_release: copy. do we want immediate rollback to v1 for those tenants or pin them to v1 while we fix? we also need to update release notes + status.

anna_prodeng: quick root cause: change in streaming frame boundary when crossing quantization boundary. temporary mitigation: fallback to legacy chunker for long sessions. I can prepare a hotpatch that flips a runtime flag in ~40 minutes.

jon_sre: hotpatch fine, but to be safe pin affected tenants to v1 during the hotpatch. gives deterministic behavior while we validate.

sara_ops: pinning now: `deploybot pin-tenant 1234 --api v1` and `deploybot pin-tenant 9876 --api v1`

deploybot: tenants 1234, 9876 pinned to v1. config commit cfg-2b7c9a.

kate_pm: I'll draft a short customer message for these tenants: "We've paused the v2 streaming rollout in EU due to chunking errors with very long sessions. You're pinned to v1 while we push a fix. No action required." ok?

mike_release: add ETA: hotpatch in 40-60m, verification 30m, then unpin & resume. include status link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1766619999

anna_prodeng: patch plan: build runtime image with flag `--chunker=legacy-longcontext`, deploy to 2 canary nodes in pool-3, run synthetic long-context smoke (100 requests), then flip for pool.

jon_sre: standing by for infra support. if hotpatch doesn't resolve, we'll rollback v2 in region eu. rollback command (requires 2 approvals): `deploybot rollback rb-1766619999 --region eu`

sara_ops: @mike_release @kate_pm can you both approve hotpatch + tenant pin?

mike_release: approved. :thumbsup:

kate_pm: approved. sending customers the short note and updating release notes to list "v2 streaming long-context chunking" as known issue with mitigation.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459 1 release-notes: v2 streaming long-context fallback.

anna_prodeng: build kicked off, will post checksum and canary hostnames when available.

sara_ops: ops checklist: monitor /v2/stream error_rate, grep for `invalid_chunk_size` in logs, run synthetic clients, prepare unpin command.

jon_sre: canary smoke started: 100 long-context streams -> 0 invalid_chunk_size so far. 15m soak running.

deploybot: canary updated: rb-1766619999-canary-a -> runtime v2.1-hotpatch.

anna_prodeng: hotpatch validated on canary. promoting to pool-3 staged rollout now. expected propagation 8-12m.

sara_ops: promoting. watching dashboards.

jon_sre: metrics back to baseline. error_rate(/v2/stream) = 0.08%. synthetic tests green.

mike_release: ok to unpin tenants and resume?

sara_ops: unpinning: `deploybot unpin-tenant 1234` `deploybot unpin-tenant 9876`

deploybot: tenants 1234, 9876 unpinned.

sara_ops: resuming rollout to pool-3 at 10% start: `deploybot resume rb-1766619999 --pool pool-3 --start 10%`

deploybot: rollout resumed.

kate_pm: release notes updated with postmortem blurb and follow-up SDK doc TODO for streaming nuance. link in PR.

mike_release: follow-ups: add a long-context synthetic to preflight for future rollouts and add chunker-boundary tests to regression suite. assigning to anna_prodeng + jon_sre.

anna_prodeng: will add unit/regression tests and a healthcheck that looks for `invalid_chunk_size` spikes.

jon_sre: will integrate synthetic into preflight pipeline and alerting.

sara_ops: closing ops loop. anything else?

kate_pm: filing incident card and logging the change under the release notes. thanks team.

mike_release: nice coordination. good catch from deploybot monitor. :clap:
